project_type: Astro 5 SSG + React interactive components + Sanity CMS v3 studio, targeting Cloudflare Pages
build_system: npm workspaces: root workspace = Astro site, /studio = separate Sanity Studio package. Root package.json manages site scripts; /studio has its own package.json. QUIRK: workspace root has pre-existing assets (Hero_Chrome_1.png, Hero_Chrome_2.png, Hero_Chrome_3.png, Pr_1.ttf, Pr_2.ttf) that must not be deleted. QUIRK: Astro cannot scaffold into a non-empty directory via CLI — scaffold into a temp dir then merge, OR write package.json and all config files manually (chosen approach). Windows PowerShell: use semicolons to chain commands, not &&; paths with spaces must be double-quoted.
test_framework: No test framework — verification is done via `npm run build` succeeding with exit code 0
verification_instructions: 1. From workspace root run: npm install  2. Run: npm run build  3. Confirm dist/ directory is created with no errors  4. Optional: npx wrangler pages dev ./dist to test Cloudflare locally
snapshot_or_generated_files: dist/ is generated by build; .astro/ is Astro's type-gen cache; both are gitignored
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell. Node 24.13.0, npm 11.6.2. Sanity init requires an authenticated sanity CLI session — studio scaffold is written manually (no sanity CLI invocation) so no auth is needed at build time. Cloudflare adapter is NOT installed (pure SSG output; static export via output:'static' in astro.config.mjs).
contribution_requirements: Preserve existing files: Hero_Chrome_1.png, Hero_Chrome_2.png, Hero_Chrome_3.png, Pr_1.ttf, Pr_2.ttf at workspace root until moved to src/assets/. Do not run interactive CLI commands.
key_patterns: Astro 5 components use .astro files with frontmatter fences. React components live in src/components/react/ and use 'use client' or client:* directives in Astro. Motion for React is imported from 'motion/react' (NOT 'framer-motion'). Tailwind CSS v3 integration via @astrojs/tailwind. TypeScript paths configured in tsconfig.json with @/* alias to src/*. Sanity client uses @sanity/client v6, image URLs via @sanity/image-url. Sanity studio is a standalone sub-project at /studio with its own node_modules.
relevant_files: src/assets/fonts/ (to create - move Pr_1.ttf, Pr_2.ttf here)
directory_structure:
AHMEDESSEKETCOM/ (root)
├── src/
│   ├── assets/
